text:
maya: Heads-up: keyboard focus ring on Insights table rows disappears in Chrome when GPU compositing is on. Also legend swatches in mini charts aren't announced.

ari: I can repro (mac Chrome 117). Outline gets clipped due to `transform` on the row wrapper.

drew: Quick fix suggestion: use box-shadow on :focus-visible instead of outline — box-shadow isn't clipped by stacking contexts. Also add forced-colors fallback for HC.

olga: Chart fix: add role="img" + aria-labelledby on SVG and give each legend item an accessible name like "Errors, red". VoiceOver read order must match visual order.

a11y-bot: Axe flagged low-contrast on selected-row text (2027-03-01) and focusable hidden element.

maya: Action items: ari -> small PR to swap outline->box-shadow and add HC CSS; drew -> ensure hidden analytics anchors are tabindex=-1; olga -> add aria labels to charts and run VoiceOver/Narrator checks. I'll file a ticket with repro and screenshots.

ari: Will add Playwright e2e to tab through rows and assert focus persists.

drew: Remember to change non-critical toasts to aria-live="polite".

maya: Thanks everyone — please link INF-4502 when you open PRs.
